Our Vision

Super House Foundation in its endeavour to provide holistic Education proudly announces the launch of Animation Master Class. The Animation School, besides developing the right values and attitude in the students will also develop their sensorial skills and aesthetic sensitivity necessary for the creative field. The school boasts of an in-house dedicated team for content development which has created an age-appropriate curriculum keeping in mind the profile of students. Besides this, we have a team of experts for training the faculty in curriculum implementation & latest developments in the field of Animation.

About Animation

Animation is a new dimension of art that uses technology to develop ideas for the creation of moving visuals. Today Digital Animation & VFX are used in Advertising, Web design, Television, Films, Medicine, Training & Education, e-learning, Legal & Insurance, 3D Visualization, Architecture etc. Another exciting area of application is the designing of games for the PC, internet, mobiles & gaming

Why Animation for Children

This course provides an exciting opportunity for students to develop their aesthetic, imaginative & expressive abilities through a combination of Art and Animation.

Developing Creative skills in the students

In today’s era of Globalization and the Web, creative thinking and problem-solving are important attributes for success. Animation training provides the necessary direction, facilities and experience to develop creativity and thereby help each individual discover his/her own identity and potential. A child develops an understanding of the multi-disciplinary nature of design and the relationship of design with environment, culture, human senses and emotions.

Special Highlights

  • Concept Development & Visualizations
  • Graphics Design & Image Editing
  • 3D Architecture & Design
  • Visual Effects
  • Visual & Sound Editing

Our Programs

Primary Level Programs (Class – 3rd& 4th)

  • An introduction world of graphics where our kids learn with fun and develop their creative skills.
  • Teaching children how they can create more effective thoughts in digital space.
  • Exploring their talents and getting familiar with the advanced yet creative technology at a young age.
  • Understanding the basic concept of digital drawing, editing and photo manipulations.

Middle Level Programs (Class – 5th&6th)

  • Developing advanced skills in graphics and Image Editing software.
  • Creating banners, posters, logos and graphics-related projects.
  • Learning image editing, colour & image correction, Layouts, and script-based designing.
  • Creating interesting effects of Images and photos.

Advanced Level Programs (Class – 7th&8th)

  • Developing an understanding of 3D concepts.
  • Creating innovative casting for events & movies.
  • Creating special visual effects for films.
  • Sound and video editing for films and events.

Our course structure is meticulously designed to cater to different age groups:

  • Classes III: Students learn design basics using shapes and tools to create caricatures and simple logos, laying a strong foundation in visual creativity.
  • Class IV: The focus shifts to colour theory, colour concepts, paint and design using brush and selection tools. Students create sketches, cartoonish effects and basic digital paintings, which enhances their artistic skills.
  • Class V: Students engage in complex design projects, including banners, logos, brochures and cards, using article writing and tracing methods to refine their creative abilities.
  • Class VI: The curriculum includes colour correction, photo retouching for photo shoots and magazines, creating VFX posters and using scripts and green screens, providing a comprehensive understanding of photo and video editing.
  • Class VII: Students delve into VFX, motion graphics, green screens and composition and gain hands-on experience in advanced animation techniques.
  • Class VIII: The focus is on designing in a 3D environment, with projects involving architectural interiors and exterior designs, preparing students for sophisticated animation work.
